blocks.text: how to grow a beard faster 3

if you want the hair to come in quickly , leave it alone while it grows . you will have the chance to groom the beard after about four to six weeks when it is full . there is no scientific evidence to support this . shaving your beard will only reduce the amount of hair on your face , not bring it in more rapidly . because your hair will not all grow at the same pace , your face might get itchy and irritated .

if you suffer from itching or a rash , ask a doctor about applying a hydrocortisone cream to your face while you are growing a beard . it will relieve the itching . however , it can also have negative side effects when used on the face , so only apply it according to doctor supervision and advice .
